_comment: Tracked (committed) attempts manifest for batch SRGRB_20260727_02, the replacement batch after SRGRB_20260727 was closed BATCH_ABORTED_EXCLUDED (see ../SRGRB_20260727/BATCH_SUMMARY.md). Filesystem slug is srgrb_20260727_02 -- never srgrb_SRGRB_20260727_02. Trial 1 Attempt 1 is INVALID: the repeatability pose-readiness gate spuriously BLOCKED (LATEST_POSE_SAMPLE_STALE) due to a recorder flush-interval/staleness-threshold incompatibility -- a procedural/instrumentation issue, not a motion or safety failure -- classified INVALID per the approved retry policy (procedural/instrumentation issues are retriable, up to 3 attempts per slot). classification=PENDING (used for a not-yet-run attempt) is a PLANNING STATE ONLY, not a result -- hil_repeatability_batch_aggregator.py's VALID_CLASSIFICATIONS is exactly VALID/INVALID/EXCLUDED, so a manifest containing any PENDING entry cannot be fed to the aggregator at all. verification_json_path is relative to this manifest's own directory, resolved by hil_repeatability_batch_aggregator.py against the manifest file's location, never the process's current working directory. Each attempt's own execution_head records the exact commit the physical stack was (or will be) brought up against for that specific attempt -- read for traceability only, not read or validated by the aggregator itself; it is per-attempt because a code fix (like the flush-interval fix after attempt 1) can land between attempts within the same batch.
